title: Corned Beef Sandwich on Wheat with Cheese

content.title: About
content.content: A corned beef and cheese sandwich served on a slice of wheat bread is a hearty, flavorful snack. The corned beef is made from brisket cured in a seasoned brine, while the cheese adds a creamy note.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Corned beef is traditionally associated with Irish cuisine and is popular on St. Patrick's Day.
Wheat bread provides slow‑release carbohydrates that help maintain energy levels.
The sandwich is convenient for on‑the‑go meals, often found in school cafeterias and picnics.
The salty beef and mellow cheese create a sweet‑salty, creamy flavor balance.
Original recipes cure the beef with mustard, cloves, and bay leaf.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Corned beef supplies high‑quality animal protein essential for muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: Red meat provides heme iron, which is more readily absorbed than plant‑based iron.

items.title: Calcium from cheese
items.content: Melted cheese adds calcium important for bone and tooth health.

items.title: Energy‑dense carbs
items.content: Wheat bread offers complex carbohydrates that promote lasting satiety.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Beef and bread contain B1, B3, and B6 vitamins that support metabolism.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Corned beef is often cured with a lot of salt, which can be an issue for hypertension.

items.title: Saturated fats
items.content: Cheese and meat can increase saturated fat intake, so moderation is advised.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Cheese may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with dairy allergies or lactose intolerance.

items.title: Gluten in bread
items.content: Wheat bread contains gluten, which should be avoided by people with celiac disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The sandwich can be enjoyed hot, lightly toasted on a grill or toaster, or cold. Slice it in half for kids or serve whole for adults. Add lettuce, tomato, or mustard for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared sandwich in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. Unopened corned beef can be stored at room temperature until the date printed on the package.
